goal: Make the Ledger Account Statements slice fully Effect-native: stored data decoded once in the entity, typed error channels with no unknown or identity catches, and idempotency-claim handling aligned with Transactions.
preserved_behavior: Routes, request and response bodies, and OpenAPI are unchanged
HTTP statuses stay 400 (bad period or oversize), 404, 409 (stale version or overflow), 503, 500
A corrupt claimed id on the replay path stays 400 (InvalidId extends BadRequestError)
SQL text, repeatable-read capture, 10,000-entry and 16 MiB limits, and lockVersion concurrency are unchanged
Responses are byte-identical for rows the repo wrote (UTC DateTime.toISO() equals Date.toISOString())
deviations: LedgerAccountStatement.integration.test.ts was removed after review: docs/standards/api.md forbids full-stack journey suites; the replay-after-annotation assertion moved to a boundary test.
updateAnnotations now sets updated with the database clock (sql now()) to match created; this is a deliberate SQL change decided in review (f25).

The service completes the idempotency claim with id.toString().

tasks.description: Add StatementPersistenceFailure, StatementRepositoryUnavailable, the StatementInfrastructureError union and mapStatementInfrastructureError(cause: EffectDrizzleQueryError | SqlError) to StatementErrors.ts; isPostgresUnavailable maps to unavailable, everything else to the persistence failure. In the repo, map once per method on the outer pipe: the four non-transaction methods use Effect.catchTag("EffectDrizzleQueryError", ...); createStatement uses Effect.catchTag(["EffectDrizzleQueryError", "SqlError"], ...). A handler for a tag absent from a method's error type does not compile, so do not share one table. Domain errors pass through typed (oversize BadRequestError, missing Account NotFoundError, overflow ConflictError). An INSERT that returns no row becomes StatementPersistenceFailure. The repo keeps NotFoundError for a missing Statement or Account and ConflictError for a stale lockVersion. validateStatementPeriod becomes an Effect: one Effect.try around both DateTime.fromISO calls with a named catch returning BadRequestError, then an ordering check failing with the same message; drop the dead isValid checks; still return Dates. calculateStatementBalances becomes an Effect that range-checks against INT64_MIN and INT64_MAX and fails with ConflictError with the same message and retryable false. The service validates the period once, before the claim, and passes the parsed period to the repo, which no longer validates. Delete the repo test 'rejects reversed periods without saving a statement' (covered by the service test) and update createStatement call sites in the repo tests. Each repo and service signature names its errors; service signatures also include InvalidId and the idempotency errors. Delete mapError, every unknown error channel and the three identity Effect.try blocks.

tasks.description: Add isStatementInfrastructureError to StatementErrors.ts: a type guard over the typed create error union (not unknown) using an instanceof trio over the three infrastructure classes, as releaseFailedMutation does. In createLedgerAccountStatement's tapError, retain the idempotency claim when the guard holds and release it otherwise, replacing the instanceof BadRequestError or NotFoundError check. An int64-overflow ConflictError now releases the claim, matching Transactions; this is the only intended behavior difference in the migration. Accepted consequence: if a row the repo just wrote fails to decode, the transaction rolls back and the claim stays pending until it expires, as with Transactions.
